label: Necessary-being node, possibilist K reading: there is an actual root n that is God, the one God…
paraphrase: Necessary-being node, possibilist K reading: there is an actual root n (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground) that is God, the one God (every God is n), and has the classical attributes, and n exists at every world accessible from w (Kripke box of the atom 'n exists' at w, frame class K). Actual existence of n is not part of the necessity clause.
